jobs.title: Weekend Only Unarmed Security Officer (Level II) – North Dallas $20/hour | Saturday & Sunday Only |
jobs.description:
Security Reconnaissance Team, Inc. (C13489) is hiring reliable, professional Weekend Only Non-Commissioned / Level II (Unarmed) Security Officers for our North Dallas sites.

We’re a growing Texas security company that values clear communication, dependability, and strong customer service. If you’re looking for consistent weekend work with competitive pay and a professional team, we’d like to hear from you.

Available Weekend Shifts

  • Day Shift: 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM (Saturday + Sunday)
  • Night Shift: 6:00 PM – 6:00 AM (Saturday + Sunday)

This is an unarmed, uniformed position.

What You’ll Do

  • Patrol and monitor the property to maintain a safe environment
  • Observe and report irregularities, incidents, and activities accurately
  • Control access points and inspect buildings/equipment as needed
  • Respond appropriately and notify the right people when issues arise
  • Complete clear, timely reports
  • Uphold client standards and company policies at all times

Requirements (Must Have)

  • Valid Texas Level II Non-Commissioned (Unarmed) Security License
  • Minimum age of 21
  • Reliable transportation and a working cell phone
  • Ability to communicate clearly in English
  • Ability to pass a criminal background check
  • Drug-free (we are a Drug-Free Workplace)
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States

What We Offer

  • $20.00 per hour
  • Bi-weekly pay via direct deposit
  • Uniforms provided
  • Free continued training (state licensing support, re-qualification, and related skills)
  • Supportive team environment with opportunities for additional hours or advancement as available
  • Equal opportunity employer – military veterans are strongly encouraged to apply

Job Type: Part-time (Weekend Only)
Work Location: In person – North Dallas area (Richardson, TX 75081 and surrounding sites)
Schedule: Saturday and Sunday only – choose Day (6 AM–6 PM) or Night (6 PM–6 AM)

If you meet the requirements and want steady weekend work with a professional security team, apply today. We look forward to reviewing your application.

Pay: $20.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Employee discount
  • Health insurance
  • Referral program
  • Vision insurance

License/Certification:

  • Level II or Level III security license (Required)

Work Location: In person
